title: Man. Post. Cap. IV: PLAC — Garissolius alto silentio
pass_a_gloss: PLAC. This second reason D. Garissolius passed over in deep silence.
pass_b_english: Placeus. Garissoles met this second argument with total silence.
source_text: PLAC. Hanc secundam rationem D. Garissolius alto Silentio praeteriit.
notes: Cap. IV Secunda ratio densify section 226 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 195 tip–198 tip).
